host.description: Reserved for GitHub Enterprise Server. relgap doesn't read it yet and always calls github.com.

ttl_override.description: Per-source TTL overrides as Go durations, e.g. {endoflife: 24h}.

roots.description: Directories scanned by drift and pins when no roots are given.

ci_actions.description: Also report the uses: pins of GitHub Actions in workflow files. Tool versions in CI files are read either way.

extra_files.description: Extra glob patterns read by the renovate-comment detector, and by the generic detector when it is on.

tools.description: Local tool overrides and additions, keyed by tool name.

aliases.description: Maps a raw pin name (e.g. TG_VERSION) to a tool name.

tool.description: Tool name, as pins and digests show it, to leave out of reports.

path.description: Glob; when set, the tool is ignored only under matching paths.

ignore.description: Tools (optionally limited to paths) that are never reported.

fail_on.description: --fail-on values each command uses when the flag is not given; a command ignores the values it doesn't check.

min_confidence.description: Entries below this confidence are hidden.

vuln_severity.description: Lowest OSV rating --fail-on vuln counts; empty counts every advisory.

model.description: Model ID the provider runs. Required when provider is set.

base_url.description: API base URL. Required for openai-compatible; anthropic and bedrock-mantle have a default.

api_key_env.description: Name of the env var holding the API key. Keys are never read from files.

api.description: bedrock-mantle only. Empty means messages for anthropic.* model IDs and chat-completions otherwise.

aws_profile.description: AWS profile for bedrock and bedrock-mantle. Empty means the default credentials.

max_input_tokens.description: Largest prompt, in estimated tokens. Lower-confidence entries are dropped first to fit.

timeout.description: Hard limit on the model call, as a Go duration. A timeout is a warning.

title: relgap configuration
description: Schema for $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/relgap/config.yaml and .relgap.yaml. Generated from internal/config by `mise run test:golden -- -update`; do not edit.
